tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud 'joms rol ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā stī/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud 'joms rol ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / cho ga 'di'i dbang du byas nas don gsum ste/ dmigs par bya ba'i yul/ bsgrub par bya ba'i thabs/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni gzhi 'bras kyi de kho na nyid nas gang la mngon spyod bya ba'i yul gyi bar ro/ /gnyis pa la drug ste/ phun tshogs lnga dang ldan pas gzhi bca' zhing*/ /sgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i las rim bstan/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa dngos la 'jug /slob ma dkyil 'khor gzhugs shing dbang bskur bshad/ /gsum tshan gnyis kyis kha skongs las 'jug bsdu/ / bshags bsdoms las kyis phra mo'i nyes pa sbyang*/ zhes pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub po gnas dang rdzas dang yo byad dus/ zhes bya ba slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid sogs te gzhan du gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ bh+ruṃ rat+na pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ phyogs skyong ba bcu gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ in+t+ra ye/ ag+na ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ṛ te/ bā ru ṇa/ bā ya be/ ku be ra/ i shā na/ prah+ma pri thi wī de wī swāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ uta ga te sa s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa la sogs pa/

sarba bhū te bh+yau sa pā ri wa re bh+yaḥ/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā nāṃ ad+ya nud+pan+na twad oṃ āḥhū ཾ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi dang 'dra/ sa'i phyogs 'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te sgrub pa la 'jug par 'tshal gyi/ phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa dkar phyogs skyong ba dam tshig can rnams kyis bar chad srung ba dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i gtong grogs mdzod cig /bar ma rnams kyis kyang ru ma nga*/ phrag ma dog /phan pa'i sems kyis 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i 'phrin las ci 'grub tu mdzad du gsol/ ma rung log 'dren gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa thams cad gtor ma'i lhag ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig / ces rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te phyir dor/ gnas dang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gong bzhin a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūṃ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba/ dbus su bh+rūṃ las dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du oṃ las byung ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su/ oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams las byung ba'i mchod pa'i spṛn gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pas yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa āḥhūṃ/ rū pa'i tshab tu shap+ta gan+dha ra sa spar+she dharma dhā tu/ zhes pa rnams bcug rol mo'i sgra bya/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs 'don no/ / de ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas rdzas byin rlabs ni nyi ma phal cher la 'jug go /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/

oṃ shu+u n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dzñā nā tsakra maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ bh+rūṃ/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ shaṃ ru dra ru dri ti ra baṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po he ru ka zhes pa nas/ ting 'dzin sems dpa' a yig ge 'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar brjod/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭa/ steng du khro bo hūṃ mdzad sngo/ zhes pa nas/ mi ro'i gdan la rol gar mdzad/ ces pa'i bar du 'og nas 'byung ba ltar brjod/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug tshul ston zhing*/ nas/ gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ de 'dra'i lha tshogs nas/ dbang dang dngos grub stsol gyi bar brjod/ snying po brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ khro bo bcu'i sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ 'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsdus pa ste/ nyi ma dang po kho na la 'jug go/cho ga de rnams ni bshad 'bum so so'i rtsis mgos bsdus pa min yang gsang sngags spyi 'gros dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lag len las byung ba yin no/ /da ni sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro las rim dngos la/ sa chog mtshams gcod phyi skangs dang*/ /las gsum phur bu byin rlabs dang*/ /phur bshar 'debs dang mchod pa 'gram/ /bum pa 'god dang ma taṃ sgrol/ dang po ni/ de nas gser skyems dang gtor ma bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ zhes lan bdun tsam gyis bsngos/ spros pa byed na gser skyems rgyas pa gyer/ hūṃ dgongs shig sa bdag lha klu sde dang dpung*/

/byin rlabs bsngo ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /'phrin las gnyan po sgrub phyir sa slong gi /rin chen gter gyis sa 'di stsal du gsol/ lan gsum gyi mthar phud gtor gtor ma phyir btang*/ rol chen byas la/ sa slong zhing bka' bsgo'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le'am tshom bu bkod gtor ma dang mchod pa byin rlabs sngar bzhin bya ste gnas khang srung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa mi dgos so/ / haṃ haṃ haṃ rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas/ /kun gyi yum chen sangs rgyas spyan/ /nor 'dzin sa yi lha mo ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ pri thi wī de wī ā gats+tsha a gats+tsha dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ ba su dha ri ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ khyod ni sa 'jin gtso mo ste/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'jig rten skyong*/ gser mdog phyag na bum pa bsnams/ /'jig rten yum gyur phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nas/ rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swā s+thā nāṃ de dag ni sa blang ba'o/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta hūṃ/ lan bdun brjod/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba'o/ /las dang bya bas sbyang ba ni/ stegs bu byed pa sogs 'dir ma bshad do/ /de nas stang stabs kyis bzung ba ni/ spros pa la dga' na/ mcham yig las 'byung ba ltar/ dpal chen po'i'agying mcham la sogs pa phur bu'i rtsa mchams su grags pa rnams skabs 'dir byed pa yin zhing*/ spros pa gtso bor mi byed na mcham med kyang mchog go / slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu spros/ oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs/ oṃ dīb+ta sogs/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra nas/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs sbyang ba spyi dang mthun par/ zhi bas sbyang ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang*/ drag pos sbyang ba rnams byed pa las/ khro bo'i bstod pa'i 'jug tu/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i

nas/ gdon mi za/ zha ེ sa pa'i bar bgegs la bka' bsgo/ tshig lhug pa'i skabs/ bden pa chen pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dpal rdo rje phur bu 'phrin las kyi sgrub pa chen po rtsom pa yin gyi/ srid pa gsum gyi bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par/ zhes 'don pa spo/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bdug rdzas kyis bdug yungs kar brabs te/ 'byung bzhi'i rdzas kyis sbyang ba yang bya'o/ /de dag ni sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba'o/ / sa bzung pa la nges par bya dgos pa ni/ mchod gtor bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la 'dug nas/ /'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar yaṃ gyi mes bsregs zhes rdzas byin rlabs nas gzung bzlas pa'i 'jug gi bstod pa/ dpal gyi bka' sdod sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar du bya/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor rang gi thugs kar bsdu'o/ yang na stang stabs kyis bzung ba skabs 'dir byas kyang chog go /gnyis pa mtshams bcad pa ni sa srung ba ste/ de la dang por rgyal chen bzhi bya ra ba'i tshul du bzhag pa ni/ mtho brtsigs de la rgyal chen gyi sngags bris/ so sor mchod gtor bsham/ thog mar shar gyi de la mchod pa dang gtor ma byin rlabs sa'i lha mo'i skabs bzhin bya/ oṃ ḍhṛ ta ra ṣ+ta ya swāhā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung sku mdog dkar po go'u rgyud mangs 'dzin pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi baṃ rim nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ dh+ri ta raṣ+ta ya/ na maḥsarba sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags btags pas gtor ma 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyi mchod/ dri za dag gi bdag po rgyal/ /shar gyi phyogs rnams skyong byed pa/ /rgyal po chen po gnas srung po/ /btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dis bzhes la

/ nas/ kun 'grub shog shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung*/ / 'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ kha dog ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul che/ /bdag cag re ba bskang ba'i phyir/ /ma dag pa rnams mtshams chod cig /shar phyogs bgegs kyi mtshams chod cig /zhi ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bdag cag sgrub pa ma thon gyi bar du/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor bcas kyis gdon bgegs bar chad nang du mi btang zhing*/ dngos grub phyi la yal du mi gzhug par sgrub pa'i gtong grogs dam pa mdzod cig ces bya/ gzhan gsum la'ang de kho nas rigs 'gre ste/ oṃ bai ru ḍha ka ye swāhā/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po/ sku mdog sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa zhes tshul des so so'i mtshan dang sngags rnams spos/ grul bum dag gi= lho phyogs= rgyal po chen po lus 'phags po= lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po= lho'i bgegs rnams= mngon spyod 'phrin las= zhes 'don pa spo'o/ / de bzhin du/ nub ma la/ oṃ bi ru pā k+ṣa ya swāhā/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang sku mdog dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten 'dzin pa/ klu rnams dag gi= nub kyi= spyan mi bzang = nub phyogs na ni spyan mi bzang = nub kyi bgegs rnams= dbang gi 'phrin las= zhes 'don pa spo/ byang gi la/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ya swā hā/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ sku mdog ser po be con dang ne'u 'dzin pa= gnod sbyin dag gi= byang gi= ngal gsos po= byang phyogs na ni rnam thos bu= byang gi bgegs rnams= rgyal ba'i 'phrin las= zhes 'don pa spo/ de nas khro bo bcu jag pa'i tshul du btang ba ni/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol gom pa nyer gcig tsam gyi mtshams su 'brub khung byed par bshad kyang*/ tshad nges bzung mi dgos te/ sgrub khang gi phyi mtshams ji ltar 'os par dong chung ngu cung zad re brus la/ phur chung bcu khro bo bcur mos/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu rnams bkug ste/ 'brub khung gi nang du bcug par gyur/ steng gi 'brub khung du phur bu gcig btab ste tho bas brdungs/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ/ gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭa/ e ma bdag nyid rang byung ba/ khro bo chen po hūṃ ka ra/ sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs spros nas/ /steng na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /lcags kyus bzung la phur bus thob/ / mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru khos/ /lus kyang dum bu stong du gtubs/ snying la kī li kī la ya/ zhes brjod/ des phyogs bcu gar la rigs 'gre ste/ hūṃ kar zhes pa'i dod du/ rnam par rgyal= dbyug sngon can= gshin rje gshed/ mi g.yo mgon/ rta mchog dpal= 'dod pa'i rgyal/ bdud rtsi 'khyil= khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal ni/ stobs po che zhes sogs 'don pa spo zhing*/ steng gi dod du phyogs so so dang*/ khro bo bcu po rang rang so so'i sngags kyi 'don pa spo'o/ / de dag ni phyi mtshams bcad pa yin par 'chad do/ /de nas dam sri mnan pa ni/ ling ga'i snying gar/ ya ma dam sri staṃ bha ni dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa 'bri bar bshad/ grog la bris pa'i ling ga'am/ sngags kyi shog ril snying gar bcug pas bag zan nam khaṃ pa la byas pa'i ling gas kyang rung*/ 'brub khung du ling ga bcas la/ sde brgyad la gser skyems btang*/ e yaṃ raṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ 'brub khung yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ dri las dam sri pho mo lcags sgrog dang zhags pas bcings pa'i lus can du gyur/ bden brdar dang dgug gzhug bya/ /phur chung gcig bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bskyed/ snying po dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags mang du bzlas/ hūṃ/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas chen 'dir/ /dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /bka' las 'da' byed dam sri rnams/ /mnan zhing gzir ba'i dus la bab/ lan gsum/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ dang snying po spel ba mang du bzlas/ phur chung de ling ga'i snying gar btab/ bar mtshams rnams su yungs kar ram/ bal tshon nam/ drag sngags bzlas pa'i bye mas bkang*/ rdo rje rgyal graṃ bris pa'i g.yas pas mnan/ de yang sas g.yogs shing mnan la/ hūṃ mnan no mnan no ri rab 'og /spyings so spyings so rgya mtshor spyings/ /gtad do gtad do gshin rje'i lag /thar med 'ching ba thob par shog/ byang chub sems mchog ma skyes par/ /nam yang gtong bar ma byed cig /gtad do ma btang sho ra re/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bka' yin no/ / oṃ laṃ hūṃ laṃ daṃ sri staṃ bha ya naṃ/ spros pa la dga' na las bzhi'i bro brdungs kyang bya/ sum+bha hūṃ/ bzhi pa mang du bzla/ de nas sgo byang 'dogs pa ni/ ra'i sog pa gnyis kyi gcig la gshin rje gshed dang*/ gcig la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sku bris la/ gshin rje gshed sgo'i ya them gyi phyi dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nang du 'dogs par byed de/ gcig la bsdu na gshen rje gshed gal che bas/ de nyid sgo'i ya them gyi nang du 'dogs so/ /gang ltar yang bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las gshin rje gshed nag po/ dbyug pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ āḥkro dhai ka ya man+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ yang na 'di nyid rang gi khro bcu'i sngags kyi nang tshan gyis kyang rung ste/ /sngags gnyis po brgya rtsa tsam bzlas/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ gsang chen lhun grub pho brang na/ /bcom ldan chos rjes bka' stsal ltar/ /bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa po/ /bka' gsang gzhung chen 'di sgrub bo/ /'di la gnod cing bar gcod kun/ /sa 'di phan chad ma btang cig / phyi 'khor skyong ba'i mu ran la/ /rdo rje yal gaṃ thub par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma rā dza sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hūṃ ljang nag 'bar ba chen po'i klong dkyil nas/ /'khyil ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi 'bar ba khyed/ / rnal 'byor dam can sgrub pa'i 'bras bu rnams/ /mngon sum tshad ma'i yid bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ me tog dor/ de dag ni bar mtshams bcad pa'o/ /nang mtshams gcod pa ni/ 'og dngos gzhi gzhung las 'byung ba ltar/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dpal chen pa ོ/ zhes pa nas/ bhañdza ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ kyi bar brjod de/ don srung 'khor sgom pa ste/ de yan chad ni sa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /sa bzung ba nyid kyi lha sta gon grub pa'i phyir/ rnying ma tshad ldan phal la de ni logs su mi mdzad do/ /gsum pa phyi bshags dang phyi bskang ni/ sā tswa gdab pa/ mdo sde bklag pa/ 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs rnams la gtor ma gtong ba sogs yin te rang ngam dge 'dun gyis ji ltar 'os tsam bya'o/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i las gsum bstan pa las dang po go mā ye gtong pa ni/ 'byung lnga dang sbyar ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsis chag chag 'debs bzhin pas/

hūṃ bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdud rtsi dri chen ye shes lnga ldan pas/ /bde gshegs kun gyi gsang mchod sgrub pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ ma hā ma la pu ta maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ bka' gsang sogs/ tshig gzhan gong bzhin las/ rkang pa gnyis pa las/ dam rdzas dag pa'i bdud rtsi gur gum chus/ zhes dang*/ sngags la ma la pu ta'i gnas su mahā kud ku maṇ+ḍa la zhes dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgyun gcod byang chub sems kyi dang*/ zhes dang*/ mahā rak+ta maṇ+ḍa la zhes 'don pa spo gnyis pa thig gdab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las thig skud nag po mi bskyod pa/ oṃ las thig skud dkar po rnam snang*/ swā las thig skud ser po rin 'byung*/ āḥlas thig skud dmar po snang mtha'/ hā las thig skud ljang khu don grub kyi ngo bor gyur/ rgyal ba rigs lnga gtso bo'i sku la zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba thig skud la thim/ hūṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra= swā badz+ra= āḥbadz+ra= hā badz+ra kī li sogs 'don pa spos nas mang du bzlas/ slob ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs su gsal bas/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ sogs dang*/ slob dpon gtso bor gsal bas*/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i sogs glur blangs te/ hūṃ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /nga ni dkyil 'khor thig 'debs kyi/ /gdug can tshogs rnams gang 'khod pa/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces thig sna gtad/ hūṃ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi e yi ngang*/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por thig btab pas/ /rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /pho brang ye shes lhun gyis grub par gyur/ ban+dha dzñā na tsakra e bh+rūṃ/ zhes thig gdab bo/ /gsum pa tshon gyi bya ba la gnyis kyi tshon byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thig skud byin rlabs 'don pa spos pas rdul tshon gyis brlabs/

kī la ya lan mang du brjod/ de rjes tshon 'gyed pa'i tshe/ dkar po oṃ gyi rang bzhin las/ /zla ba shel gyi 'od zer 'phros/ /chos dbyings ye shes byin gyis brlabs/ /phur bu dngos grub thob par shog /kī la ya bzlas de bzhin du 'don pa spos te/ mthing ka hūṃ gi= in+d+ra ni la'i= me long ye shes= ser po swā yig= rin chen gser gyi= mnyam nyid= dmar po āḥyi= rin chen byu ru'i= sor rtog ye shes= ljang khu hā yi= rin chen g.yu yi= nan tan ye shes= zhes so/ /bar 'dir dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bya'o/ lnga pa phur bu byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sngar bzhin slob mas rdo rje gzhon nu'i sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyi snying rjes bsgral ba'i sogs brjod phur bu rnams re re bzhin/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa= rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ / zhes yun ring du bsgom/ hūṃ las byung ba'i phur bu rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur par mos la 'og nas 'byung ba'i lha bskyed sngags rnams tshar gcig brjod/ spro zhing nus na mngon rtogs kyi skabs las 'byung ba ltar/ zhal phyag rnams gsal btab kyang legs/ ngag nas mi brjod kyang yid kyis dmigs pas gsal thebs pa ni nges par dgos so/ /yang sngags de dag lan gcig brjod pas/ lha thams cad lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam par gyur/ hūṃ skye med rnam dag nas/ sras mchog kī la ya/ skye med chos kyi dbyings las bzhengs nas kyang*/ /srid pa rdo rje phur bu sgrub par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhuṃ baṃ hoḥtiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta ba ling ta rak+ta hoḥ hūṃ dip+ta tsakra sogs kyis bstod pa las dbu la sogs kyi dod du/ ral gri'i sgra la spu dri'i so zhes 'don pa spo/ phur pa'i lha thams cad kyi dbu la hūṃ oṃ swā āḥhā rnams las byung ba'i rgyal ba rigs lnga/

de rnams kyi 'od zer gyi sku lus gang bar gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te thim/ /phur bu'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ sked par hrīḥdamar po/ rtse mor phaṭa ser po/ de rnams kyi 'od zer 'phro 'du las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'dus par gyur pa ni/ dbal gyi logs gsum la hūṃ re/ /zur gsum la phaṭa re/ rtse mor a thung nag po'o/ /de rnams las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su 'gyur pa las/ dgra bgegs kyi sdig sgrib bsreg pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa me'i dbal du gyur/ 'og phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su 'byung ba ltar/ ma sur+ya nas/ e be sha ya a/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dz+wa la dz+wa la sogs sngags gsum gyis dbang bskur ba'i bar rnams bya/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya be ta li sogs/ yungs kar gu gul rak+ta rnams kyis gzi byin bskyed/ hūṃ khro rgyal 'jigs byed badz+ra kī la ya/ zur gsum sku gsung thugs su gzi brjid skyed/ zur bzhi ye shes bzhi ru= zlum po byams dang snying rjer= zla gam chags med dbyings su= 'byung lnga yum gyi dbyings su= bcu drug rol pa'i pho nyar= ma skyes lhun gyis grub par= gang la bya ba'i dgra bgegs rlag pa'i phyir/ su la bsnun kyang thams cad sgrol bar mdzod/ snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra kro dha sarba bud+dha ta thā ga ta ha sa ya na hūṃ/ a be sha ya a/ zhes ming du bzlas so/ /de ltar na chos skur byin gyis brlab/ /longs skur byin gyis brlab/ sprul skur byin gyis brlab/ ye shes lngar/ sku gsung thugs su thugs rtse gcig par/ 'gro don sras mchog tu dbang bskur ste bdun no/ /yang skad cig las bzhengs su gsol ba/ spyan 'dren pa/ gnyis med du stim pa/ bstod pa 'bul ba/ gzi byin bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/

dbang bskur ba ste/ bdun du byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa gang ltar byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /drug pa ni/ phur bu dkyil 'khor la 'god pa yin te/ snga rabs pa rnams phur bshar 'debs pa zhes zer ro/ / dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ / chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid las/ / bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa yang*/ /ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dīp+ta tsakra badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ steng nas rang 'byung grub pa'i lha// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid las/ /hūṃ mdzad rdo rje sgra 'byin bcas/ /phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /tshangs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur te/ shar nas= sangs rgyas sogs rkang pa gnyis kun la sbyar/ rnam rgyal rdo rje sgeg snyems= phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbang dang*/ zhes sogs kun la sbyar/ brgya byin dgyes shing sogs nas sngags brjod pa sogs kun la sbyar/ me nas= dbyug sngon rdo rje sder mor= phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo /me lha= lho nas= gshin rje dur khrod lha mor= sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo / gshin rje= lho nub= mi g.yo rdo rje gtun khung = gzigs dang khwa ta'i/ srin po= nub nas= rta mgrin rdo rje gtum mor= byi la pu shud/ chu lha= rlung nas= gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyems bcas/ spyang khu khra yi= rlung lha= byang nas= 'khyil pa rdo rje rlung 'byin= seng ge pha wang*/ gnod sbyin= byang shar= khams gsum rnam rgyal gsod mar= dred dang sbre mong = dbang ldan= 'og nas= stobs chen rdo rje skul byed=

dom dang byi ba'i= sa bdag= shar nas= rang byung grub pa'i lha/ 'gugs byed chen mo pu shud mgo /shar sgo nyi steng mi ro'i steng/ dgyes shing sogs sbyar ba dang rang sngags brjod/ de bzhin du go brjes te/ lho nas = 'ching byed chen mo bya rog mgo lho sgor= dgyes sogs/ nub nas= sdom byed chen mo srin bya'i mgo nub sgor= dgyes shing = byang nas= mnyes byed chen po khra yi mgo /byang sgor= dgyes shing = sogs sbyar/ dam can gyi phur pa 'god na/ oṃ badz+ra kī la kī la ya ma tha ma tha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ma tha sogs 'don pa spos te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ su ru su ru badz+ra/ mu ru badz+ra/ ma ma wa shaṃ ku ru/ ma te nya ka ra/ /ma ma karma shīgh+raṃ ka ra/ ka te ka ye/ a dzi te/ dza ye bi dza ye/ a ba ra dzi te/ rnams la sngar bzhin sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma ma shī gh+raṃ ka ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bzhi/ de bzhin du/ ma ra s+ya na dang*/ pra mar+dha na ya/ yang lan bzhi bzhi sbyar/ spyir de tsam gyis chog la/ spros pa la dga' na/ nam gyi srod kyi dam can ma/ sogs la/ dus la bab/ ces pa rnams bzhugs su gsol/ zhes 'don pa bsgrub bas chog go / bdun pa rgyan bkram pa ni/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan mchod rdzas sogs bsham/ shes rab ral gri yum gyi rang bzhin las/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya'i cho 'phrul ci yang rtags/ /thabs shes rang bzhin mchod pa'i lha mo rnams/ /rgyan dang mchod rdzas gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ sarba pū dza megha sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes brjod do/ /brgyad pa bum pa 'god pa'am bum pa sta gon ni/ slob ma dbang bskur dang*/ rab gnas dang bdag 'jug phal pa dang*/ sgrub pa dngos grub gyi dbang len pa rnams la bum sgrub nges par dgos la/ sgrub mchod tsam la ni bum pa nges par dgos pa min yang 'grub na ni legs so/ / de la bum sgrub dngos ni/ bdag mdun bum gsum dbyer med du sgrub pa yin la/ 'dir bum pa bsham pa ste/ bum pa rnams la yungs kar gtor zhing gu gul gyi gdug pas bgegs bskrad/

dri bzang gi chu la bdud rtsi a mṛ tas btab pas bkang*/ shing 'o ma can gyi yal gas kha rgyan bya/ gzhan spyi dang mthun par bshams te/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa re dang*/ khro bcu'i sngags nyer gcig re bzla/ thams cad kyi thun mong du/ ki lā ya stong phrag sogs mang du bzlas nas dkyil 'khor la dgod par bya'o/ /de yang bum pa bcu gcig yod na/ dbus ma rnam rgyal bum pa la gtso bo yab yum dang*/ / gzhan bcu po la khro bcu bzla ba yin pas/ gtso bum mañdzi sogs kyi steng du bkod nas/ dbus su 'jog pa sogs lha so so'i rang gnas su 'god dgos rgyu yin yang 'god tshul stabs mi bde na/ gtso bum shar sgo'i thad kyi g.yon dang*/ gzhan rnams rdo rwa'i nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad la 'god do/ /bum pa gcig las med na shar sgo'am nub sgo gang 'thad du bkod kyang chog /'dir bsang dgos pa rnams bdud rtsi'am nyung kar gtor bas byed pa'i phyir/ /las bum dang bsang chu mi dgos la/ ci ste byed na byang gi bum pa nyid las bum yin pas/ bsang chur byed na'ang las thams cad pa'i bum chu de nyid dung phor du blangs pas so/ /rnying ma'i yig rnying 'ga' re na yang bum pa sta gon spyi dang mthun pa'i lugs kyang 'dug pas/ de ltar 'gal ba med mod kyi rang lugs de tsam gyis chog go /dgu pa ma taṃ sgrol ba ni/ slob dpon hūṃ kā ras mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi dkyil chog na/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bskyed zin pa'i rjes su/ /ma taṃ sgrol ba drag po'i rol gar mang po dang bcas te/ sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa'i tshul du mdzad pa nyid rtsa ba'i khungs yin pas spyir de dang mthun na legs kyang*/ gong ma mang po zhig skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i don du/ ma traṃ sgrol ba bsdus pa re mdzad pa yang rnying ma rang lugs gyi rgyud gzhung don la gnas pa'i phyir/

sgrub par bya ba kho na'o/ /de yang ma taṃ gi ling ga bcas nas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge dri las byung ba'i rnam pa ma taṃ ga ru dra'i gzugs can/ /ngo bo sgrub pa po dngos grub sgrub pa la gegs byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren byad ma kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo gdug can de nyid dbang med du 'gyel zhing sa la lhung bar gyur/ bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs ka nas khro bo mi g.yo ba 'khor dang bcas pa spros par gyur/ hūṃ dur khrod gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /thabs dang shes rab rol pa las/ /za byed 'bar ba'i rngam stabs kyis/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /'joms byed chen po ār+ya a tsa la/ /mnyes byed rdo rje srin po sen rnon ma/ rdo rje phra men gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /sdang dgra gnod byed sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lan gsum/ ling ga bskyed cing pho nya spro ba'o/ /bden brdar brjod cing*/ dngos grub la bar du gcod cing bstan pa la gnod par byed pa'i sdang dgra gnod byed 'gegs dang log 'dren byad ma la sogs pa ma taṃ gi rigs su gnas shing bdud kyis byin brlabs pa gnod byed ru dra thams cad/

ces 'don pa spos te dgug gzhug bya/ thar pa'i lam 'byed dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /skal ldan tshogs rnams 'ongs pa ltar/ / ru dra 'dir shog rigs kyi bu/ / bde bar 'ongs so legs par shog / snying po'i mthar mi g.yo ba'i sngags sbyar/ ma taṃ ka ru tra ā ka sha tri yaṃ dza bā ma ra ya dza dza/ zhes lan gsum gyi sa bos te ma traṃ 'bod cing dgug pa'o/ /sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ ma taṃ ka ru tra a be sha ya a a/ lan gnyis shu rtsa gcig gis gzugs brnyan la dbab pa'o/ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ mang du bzlas shing*/ gzugs brnyan 'brub khung du bcug /mgo lho nub dang rkang pa byang shar du bstan/ pho mo gnyis yod na bsnol mar bzhag zhabs kyi 'og du mnan par bsam/ / mthar byed chen po'i 'gying stabs kyis/ /sgrol bdag zhabs ni g.yas pa yi/ /ru dra pho mo'i steng nas gnon/ sa ma ya dz+wa la tsit+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ma taṃ mnan pa'o/ /phur chung gcig gam gnyis ling ga la btab ste/ khog pa dral zhing sgo dbye ste/ /lhun grub dbyings kyi sgo dbye'o/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i phur pa yis/ /yul las 'das pa'i sgo phye shig snying po dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyi mthar/ ma taṃ ga ru dra ud gha ḍa ya/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ma taṃ khog pa dral ba'o/ / raṃ yaṃ khaṃ zhes mang du bzlas ru dra'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs par bsam/ sgrib pa sbyang ba'o/ / oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba pre ta ga te he du+u na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba tir+ya ga te he du+u na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he du+u na hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags gsum po de mang du bzlas pa ni ngan song gi sgo bkag pa'o/ / de yi khams dang skye mched rnams/ /sems kyi ngo bor rab bsdus te// byang chub sems kyi dbyings nyid du/ khams gsum 'khor ba kun bsdu'o/ /tra ི hūṃ bodhi tsit+ta saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ zhes byang chub sems su bsdus/ de ni hūṃ la bsdu ba'o/ / zla dkyil hūṃ gi sbyor bas 'phangs/

phaṭa kyis shes rab lhums su bskyod/ /bde gshegs rigs kyi sras su skyes/ /'gro ba'i don du dbang yang bskur/ /āḥhūṃ yaṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ zhes gnas spar ba'o/ / bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas 'jig /sdig pa'i las kyis sdug bsngal bskyed/ /nga yi bstan pa 'dir zhugs shig /'on tang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dral/ zhes chos bstan pa'o/ / chos nyid skye 'gag med pa yang*/ /bde bar gshegs dang 'gro ba zhes/ /bdag med pas na mnyam nyid sku/ /thugs rje chen pos cis mi 'dzin/ zhes lta ba bstan pa'o/ / ma taṃ chen po'i khog pa la/ /he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad gyur/ /dkyil 'khor chen por bzhugs pa'o/ /bh+rūṃ bi shwa be shud+dhe e waṃ ma ya/ maṇ+ḍa la raṃ/ zhes bzla zhing*/ ling ga gtubs te mgo bo bden bral/ lag gnyis lho dang nub/ sked pa g.yas g.yon me dang rlung*/ rkang pa shar dang byang*/ pho rtags dbang ldan du bor te/ gzhal yas khang du bstan pa'o/ /de ltar na/ pho nya spros dang dgug gzhug dang*/ gzugs la dbab cing zhabs kyi mnan/ khog pa dral dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ /ngan song sgo bkag hūṃ la bsdu/ /gnas spar chos bshad lta ba bstan/ /gzhal yas khang bsgyur bcu gnyis so/ /zhes pa ni ma taṃ sgrol ba'i sdoms so/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa dngos la 'jug pa ni/ 'dir dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni bdag mdun bum gsum dbyer med yin par go dgos so/ /de yang sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo'am/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyang 'dir byas na legs/ /sman rag byin rlabs kyi rjes su byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la sdoms ni/ tshad med mtshams bcad brdar sgo dbye/ /brda'i phyag 'tshal rtags kyis 'debs/ dam 'cha' bshags pa byin 'bebs dang*/ /yo byad byin rlabs bsnyen phur bskyed/ ces pa ltar sbyor ba'i chos bcu las/

dang po tshad med sgom pa ni/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*/ /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog gnyis pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur/ thugs kar hūṃ nag po 'od zer 'bar ba/ de las khro bo bcu spros phyogs bcur 'khod/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhā ni la dan+ḍa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān ta ka hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gh+ṝ ba hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra krodha a pa ra dzi ta hūṃ/ /oṃ badz+ra kro d+dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha mahā ba la hūṃ/ gdug cing sdangasems ldan pa rnams/ /lha'am 'on te bdud kyang rung*/ / nga la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka'/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun gyi bka'/ /chos nyid bden pa'i bka' 'di yis// srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /na rag dmyal khams yan chad kyi/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs/ /sgrub la bar gcod 'tshe ba dang*/ /dkyil 'khor lta bar mi dbang zhing*/ /phyag rgya sgom dang bzlas pa dang*/ /gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba/ /de dag thams cad da lta nyid/ /myur ba kho nar gzhan du dengs/ /gal te bka' las 'da' byed na/ /yak+sha me dbal rab khros te/ /lus sems rdul du brlag nas kyang*/ /mi bzad dmyal ba chen por lhung*/ /mtshon cha rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /'jigs par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'du ba'i lha ni ma gtogs pa/

/gsang ba'i dam can so so nas/ /kun kyang thugs dam skongs zin gyi/ /so so'i gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ /yungs kar gtor zhing drag rol dang bcas/ khro bo bcu'i sngags drag tu bzlas te bgegs bskrad/ nga yi dkyil 'khor bstan bya'i phyir/ khro rgyal byin rlabs las 'byung ba'i/ /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srung*/ /hūṃ steng yang rdo rje'i bla re gur/ 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi la/ / phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtams/ rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig/ steng yang 'khor lo'i bla re gur/ sogs rdo rja ེ'i dod du 'khor lo bcug pa dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rgya gram dang*/ ral gri dang*/ be con zhes pa rnams bcug ste 'don pa spo/ oṃ badz+ra te dza tiṣ+ṭha tsakra rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum ste mtshams bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ dkyil 'khor shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi nas/ ye shes bzhi yi sgo mo rab phye ste/ /byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang snyoms kyi/ /'phags pa'i zhal bzang bdag la bstan du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra maṇ+ḍa la pra be sha ya phaṭa/ / bzhi pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ 'jigs byed gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje yab yum mched dang lcam dral tshogs/ /mchog gi sgo gsum dang ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /brda dang gar gyis mchod nas phyag bgyi'o/ /a ti bhu ho pra ti bhu ho/ / lnga pa rtags btab pa ni/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mkha' 'gro gying dang ma mo'i tshogs lhan cig /rnal 'byor dag pa gsum la 'god pa'i phyir/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen mtshan mas btab/ ma hā rak+ta ni hūṃ/ ma hā smig ta hūṃ/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti bhasma hūṃ/ / drug pa dam 'cha' ba ni/ las byang so so na tshig rigs mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang don gcig pas 'gal ba med la/

'dir ni rgyun bshags nyid dam bca' yin te/ yan lag bdun pa'i nang du de thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i 'gegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dgongs pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ zhes rgyun chags lan gsum gyis dam bcas/ /bdun pa bshags pa ni/ dam tshig nyer brgyad kyi bshags pa sogs dang*/ zhi khro'i bshags pa ye shes sku mchog sogs rgyas pa rnams spro zhing nus na bya la bsdu na/ hūṃ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ / rtsa ba yan lag nyes byas phra mo dang*/ / dam tshig che chung tshor dang ma tshor dang*/ / zla dang zhor gyis dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ khas blangs che la nyams blangs chung ba dang*/ /bka' ltar ma bgyis gzhung ltar ma bsrangs dang*/ /ting 'dzin lhod gyur 'dzab bzlas nyung pa dang*/ /yi dam lha yi sgom pa g.yel ba sogs/ /nyams grib nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ /kun rdzob rgyu mtshan tsam gyi dbang gis ni/ /rang nongs 'gyod pa'i tshul gyis mthol lo bshags/ /byams pa'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang*/ /gnyis med dbyings las mi 'gyur bdag bkod nas/ /mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang du bzhugs nas kyang*/

/gnyis med don gyi tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bshags pa lan gsum bya/ dzaḥhuṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ /brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūṃ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs byin rlabs can/ /tshur gshegs dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /sgrub mchod rnal 'byor bdag la dbang cig bskur/ hūṃ a la la ho/ hūṃ hūṃ huṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hūṃ/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byin gyis rlobs pa'i dus la bab/ /dbang chen bskur ba'i dus la bab/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen mthun stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen byin rlobs bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ / dgu pa yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ raṃ gyi mes bsregs/ yaṃ gyi rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ gi chus bkrus/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bh+rūṃ las ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod chen po rnams su/ oṃ las 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam kyis mi khyab pa/ mkha' dbyings thams cad gang bar gyur/ phud dang gtor ma'i gnas su/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ bdud rtsi'i snod la nyi zla rdo rje'i kha gcod can/ /nang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ hūṃ oṃ swā āḥhā rnams kyis mtshan pa dang*/ gtor ma'i snod du sha lnga la muṃ laṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ rlung g.yos/ me spar/ rdzas rnams zhu/ oṃ badz+ra ḍhṛka /oṃ dzi na dzi ka /swā rat+na ḍhṛ ka āḥ.a ro li ka /hā pra dzñā dhṛka /muṃ badz+ra dhā tu/ laṃ mo hā rā ti/ māṃ dwe ṣa rā ti/ pāṃ rā ga rā ti/ tāṃ badz+ra rā ti/ sman la rgyal ba rigs lnga dang*/ /gtor ma la yum lnga rnams 'khod/

sa ma ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa sogs lan gsum/ 'khor 'das kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug /de thams cad dam rdzas sman dang gtor ma la 'dres pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrī tha/ zhes pa nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa brgyad/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba liṃ ba te gu h+ya sid+dha sa ma ya hūṃ hri tha/ ra yig las rak+ta'i snod dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ra yig gis mtshan pa'i gdan la/ raṃ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po mtha' yas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ hrī tha/ rgya cher 'phel ba la khams gsum gyi rak+ta thams cad bkug ste de la thim par gyur/ gtor ma dang rak+ta byin rlabs kyi sngags kyang bdun nam nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi 'gro de gong du ma song na skabs 'dir bya mod/ gong du byed pa nyid lag len gtso che'o/ /bcu pa bsnyen phur bskyed pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ e las byung ba gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du/ pad nyi dang dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la hūṃ spros/ hūṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu yum dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra ki li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i phur bur gyur/ de'i rtse mor dpal rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum/ rgya mdud gong ma la khro bo bcu/ chang bzung la za byed gsod byed nyi shu /rgya mdud 'og ma la sgo srungs bzhi sogs 'khor bar gyur/ kī la ya 'bru bcu drug pa lan bdun bzlas te/ bsnyen pa'i phur bu byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /'dir bsnyen phur dang sras mchog tha dad du byed pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i skabs/ bsnyen phur dang bdag nyid dbyer med du dmigs pa yin la/

de ltar na bsnyen phur dngos grub kyi rdzas yin gyi bsgral las la mi 'jug cing*/ bsgral las sras mchog gis mdzad la/ 'di rdo rje'i phur bu dang*/ sras mchog ni ri rab phur bur bya mod kyi/ spyir mtha' gcig tu nges pa ni ma yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ lha sgoms mchod pa dang*/ sngags kyi bzlas pa gnyis so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyu ting nge 'dzin gsum/ 'bras bu dkyil 'khor gsum/ mdzad 'phrin mchod pa gsum zhes bya'o/ /dang po ni/ hūṃ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thigs pa shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba na/ /snying gi go ru bsgom par bya/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ / rang bzhin ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams byang chub la 'god par bya'o/ / kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ / stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rang sems hūṃ yig mthing nag nam mkha'i khams su gnas par gyur/ oṃ dhar+m+ma dha du swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ de ni rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu dkyil 'khor gsum bskyed pa la/ rten gzhal yas khang 'khor bcas bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa dkyil 'khor rnam gsum dngos bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/

nam mkha'i hūṃ las spros pa'i raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis snod bcud thams cad sbyangs/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ taṃ keṃ bh+rūṃ rnams spros pa las rten gyi dkyil 'khor grub pa ni/ e yig nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ baṃ las chu/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du raṃ las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ de'i dbus su keṃ las keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri rab/ /bh+rūṃ bi shwa bi shud+dhe ban+dha dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ bh+rāṃ/ ri rab kyi steng du bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rab tu 'jigs shing kyi g.ya' ba/ gnam lcags ur mo'i gzhi la gnas pa/ thod pa skam rlon gyis brtsigs pa la rak+ta'i zhal chu 'bab cing*/ 'dod snam dang pha gur bcas pa rkang lag gi shar bu dang*/ sgal tshigs kyi mda' yab can/ rus pa'i dra phyed dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi dang*/ /skra'i rnga yab dang*/ thod tshal gyi zla ba dang*/ /mi ro'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ zhing lpags kyi 'phan gdugs dang bla re la sogs pas brgyan pa/ rta babs dang sgo'i phyi rol ro langs dang keng rus kyi ka ba can/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du rus sbal chu srin lha chen klu chen gza' skar 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba las grub pa'i ka gdung gral phyam la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bar bar thams cad rin po che'i rang bzhin zla ba dang nyi ma ltar 'od zer 'phro ba/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor mi mgo dang rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa'o/ / 'di khro dkyil gyi lugs yin/ zhi dkyil ltar na spyi dang 'dra mod de gtso mi che'o/ / gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i steng du paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ gis sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ gis zla ba'i gdan/ /ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ gis nyi ma'i gdan/ shaṃ ru dra ru dri ti ra baṃ gyis ru dra pho mo g.yas g.yon du mgo bstan te 'gyel ba'i gdan rnams su gyur/

gnyis pa la bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spro ba/ phur bu rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i rang sems hūṃ yig de gzhal med khang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ khyad par du gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ si ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po he ru ka khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ /dus mtha'i sprin ltar sku mdog nag /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /rab khros shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku/ /sku che rags shing sbom la thung*/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags kyang 'gril/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gi dang po ni/ /rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar zhing gsor/ /gnyis pas rdor rje rtse lnga bsnams/ /g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub can/ /me dpung bsnams pas gdug can sreg /gnyis pa mdung rtse gsum pa yis/ /rtse mor mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga /tha ma mdun gyi phyag gnyis kyis/ /ri rab phur bu bsgril ba'i tshul/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas/ /ru dra pho mo mnan zhing brdzis/ /stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/ /glang lpags zhing chen stod g.yogs gsol/ /thod pa tshar gsum 'phreng bas brgyan/ /gdug pa'i sprul gyis brgyan pa ste/ /rgyal rigs dkar po thod du bcings/ /rje rigs ser pos mgul pa brgyan/ /dmangs rigs dmar po snyan char byas/ /bram ze ljang khu gdu bu ste/ /ske rags dang ni se mo do/ /klu chen gdol pa nag po'o/ / thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang*/ /rak+ta dmar gyi thig le dang*/

/zhag chen zo ris rnams kyis mtshan/ /sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar/ /dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'khyil/ /rdo rje'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon gdengs/ /sku lus rdo rjes go char gtams/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ /skra dang ba spu'i khung bu sogs/ /thams cad rdo rje gzhon nus gtams/ / thugs kar so bzhi'i tshad tsam gyi/ /gzhal med khang pa sgo gcig pa/ /sgo srung rta mgrin rim par bcas/ /de nang nyi ma la gnas pa'i/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar hūṃ/ /mtha' skor sngags 'phreng 'khod par gyur/ /oṃ dīp+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi/ /g.yas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yon pa thod khrag yab la stob/ khro mo'i cha byad yongs rdzogs pa/ /dpal chen sku la gnyis med 'khyud/ / thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' a yig go / hūṃ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ /phung po rdo rjer gtams byas nas/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hūṃ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /srid pa rdo rjer grub 'dzod cig /yang hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzad/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs gnas gsum du thim/ hūṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /dang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa/ /sku yi dbyig tu bdag skyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/

oṃ= waka= haṃ/ oṃ= tsit+ta= haṃ/ yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha thams cad spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ hūṃ thabs kyi spyod pa'i 'gro don du/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ / dbang dang byin rlabs bdag stsol cig /rigs lnga rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhe shwa hūṃ/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha dhe shwa rī oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhe shwa rī drāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhe shwa ri hrī/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhi shwa ri a/ gnyis pa phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spro ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad kyi ngo bo phyogs skyong bcu chung mar bcas pa bkug ste 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams kyi steng du pad nyi la bzhag gtso bo'i thugs ka nas hūṃ bcu spros te de rnams kyi steng du 'khod/ de rnams khro bcu 'khor dngabacas par gyur ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭa/ steng du khro bo hūṃ mdzad sngo/ /zhal gsum mthing dkar dmar ba ste// rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang*/ /bar pa 'phreng ba mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /tha ma phur bu bsgril zhing 'debs/ /tshangs pa pho mo mnan zhing brdzis/ /lha mo rdo rje sgra 'byin 'khyud/ /sprul pa phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūṃ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ /shar du khro bo rnam rgyal dkar/ /zhal gsum dkar dmar nag pa ste/ / rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang*/ /bar ma rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzin/ /mtha' gnyis phur bu bsgril zhing 'debs/ /brgya byin pho mo mnan zhing brdzis/ /lha mo rdo rje sgeg snyems 'khyud/ /sprul ba stag dang bya rgod mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa/ shar lhor khro bo dbyug sngon nag

/zhal gsum nag dkar dmar ba ste/ rtsa phyag= bar pa dbyug tho me dbal bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis= me lha pho= lha mo rdo rje sder mos 'khyud/ /sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ lho phyogs gshin rje gshed po nag /zhal gsum mthing dkar dmar ba ste/ rtsa phyag= bar pa dbyug tho dgra sta 'dzin/ mtha' gnyis= gshin rje pho mo= lha mo rdo rje dur khrod 'khyud/ sprul ba sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ā r+ya a tsa la hūṃ ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ lho nub khro bo mi g.yo smug zhal gsum smug dkar ljang ba= rtsa phyag= bar pa ral gri/ zhags pa= mtha' gnyis= srin po pho mo= lha mo rdo rje gtun khung = sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hūṃ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ nub tu khro bo rta mgrin dmar/ dmar dkar mthing nag= rtsa phyag= bar pa pad+ma sprul zhags= mtha' gnyis= chu bdag pho mo= rdo rje gtum mo= sprul pa byin pu shud mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṣa tiṣ+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ nub byang gzhan gyis mi thub dmar/ zhal gsum dmar dkar ljang khu= rtsa phyag= bar pa lcags kyu rnga yab= mtha' gnyis= rlung lha pho mo= rdo rje mda' snyems= sprul pa spyang ki bya khra'i mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang*/ zhal gsum ljang dkar dmar po= rtsa phyag= bar pa rgya gram dbyug tho= gnod sbyin pho mo= rdo rje rlung 'byin= sprul pa seng ge pha wang mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha tre lo kya bi dza ya hūṃ/ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ byang shar khams gsum rnam rgyal ljang*/ /zhal gsum ljang nag ser po= rtsa phyag= bar pa rdo rje dri shu /mtha' gnyis= dbang ldan pho mo= rdo rjer gsod byed= sprul pa dred dang sre mong mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūṃ/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ 'og phyogs stobs chen du ba'i mdog

/zhal gsum dung dkar dmar ba= rtsa phyag= bar pa tho ba gtun shing = mtha' gnyis= sa bdag pho mo= rdo rje skul byed= sprul pa dom dang bya ba'i mgo /khro bo yab yum nyi shu yang*/ /rgyan dang cha byad rnam 'gyur rnams/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo yab yum mtshungs/ /yum rnams yab dang sku mdog mtshungs/ /g.yas phyogs pho nya mche ba can/ /za byed thams cad skyes pa'i tshul/ /g.yon phyogs phyag brnyan sder mo can/ /gsod byed thams cad bud med lus/ /sprul pa khra thabs nyi shu rnams/ /thams cad rang rang khro bo yi/ /sku mdog rtsa ba mtshungs pa las/ /rnam sprul ma nges cir yang ston/ khro mo bcu dang pho nya kun/ /phyag na phur bu thod khrag 'dzin/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya bi da ya baṃ baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ shar phyogs sgo ma gnod sbyin mo/ /dkar mo pu shud mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya na ma sa man+ta hriṃ hriṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lho phyogs sgo ma 'jigs byed ma/ /ser mo ke ka'i mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje zhags pa thogs/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya su ru su ru pra su ru hūṃ phaṭa/ nub phyogs sgo ma bdud rtsi ma/ /dmar mo srin bya'i mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas lug brgyud lcags sgrogs thogs/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ /byang phyogs sgo ma gsod byed ma/ /ljang nag khra yi mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas 'bebs bya dril bu 'dzin/ /de ltar sgo ma bzhi po rnams/ /phyag g.yon rdo rje phur bu 'debs/ / mi ro'i gdan la rol gar mdzad/ /'khor rnams kun kyang gshog rgyangs can// phyi rol dam can khor yul ga /ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ shar stod du/ sho na mu kha mthing nag lcags spyang mgo dgu pa la zhon pa/ g.yas thod dbyug 'dzin pa/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ lho stod du shrī ka mu kha ser nag gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la zhon pa/ g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ su ru su ru badz+ra nub stod du sri la mu kha dmar nag zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la zhon pa/

g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mu ru mu ru badz+ra/ byang stod du shwa na mu kha ljang nag g.yu'i khyi mo ral pa can la zhon pa/ g.yas zhing chung zhal du gsol zhing*/ de bzhi char yang g.yon rang rigs kyi phur bu thogs pa'o/ /hūṃ ma ma wā sh+yaṃ ka ri hūṃ/ shar smad du/ re ma tī mthing nag dre'u rkang gsum la zhon pa/ dri shul dang me long 'dzin pa/ /ma taṃ nya ka ra/ lho smad du re ma dza ser mo sha ba yu mo la 'chibs shing*/ g.yas gser gyi zor ba dang*/ g.yon g.yu'i snod thogs pa/ i nan da dhi/ nub smad du re ma hri dmar nag chu glang la zhon pa/ lcags kyu dang ban+dha 'dzin pa/ ma ma shīgh+raṃ karma ka ra ye/ / byang smad du re ma dzu ljang nag rnga mong la zhon pa/ khraṃ shing dang mtshon gyi grub gu thogs pa'o/ /yang thams cad kyang phyag g.yon na mchog phur ro/ /ka tang ka ye/ shar du rdo rje ya sbyin mthing nag lcags kyu dang bya phur 'dzin pa/ g.yu 'brug la 'chibs pa/ lhor rdo rje de sbyin ser mo zhags pa dang byi dur gyi phur pa 'dzin pa/ chu srin pir la zhon pa/ a dzi te/ nub tu rdo rje bse sbyin dmar mo lcags sgrog dang mchog phur 'dzin pa/ glog dmar la 'chibs pa a pa ra dzi ti/ byang du rdo rje phag byi ljang khu dril bu ser lding gi phur pa 'dzin pa/ chu rta sngon po la 'chibs pa'o/ /ma ma shī gh+raṃ karma ka ra ye/ shwa na ma bzhi'i ming po ni/ pra ma rā dza srin po'i gying dkar po dung phur bsgril ba/ ya ma rā dza gshin rje'i gying sngon po lcags phur bsgril ba/ da sha ghṛ ba bdud kyi gying dmar po zangs phur bsgril ba/ yag sha ghṛ ba gnod sbyin gyi gying ser po gser phur bsgril ba/ mā ra se na bdag nyid chen mo'i ming po rnams ni/ shar bdud dkar po mche ba 'dzin pa/ lho bdud sngon po be con= nub bdud dmar nag gzhags pa= byang bdud ljang nag ral gri= pra man+dha na ya hūṃ/ sa bdag chen mo rnams kyi ming po ni/

/srin po'i gyad chen dkar po/ gshin rje'i gyad chen nag po/ bdud kyi gyad chen mig ring dmar po/ gnod sbyin gyad chen mon pa sngon po ste/ de bzhi char yang g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs pa dang*/ g.yon rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i phur bu 'dzin pa/ ming po thams cad kyang sku che la yan lag rags pa/ mi gdug cing 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ za za 'cha' 'cha' rngam rngam 'dra ba'o/ /de ltar dpal chen po dkyil 'khor bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa ye shes chen po'i rol pa las rang shar ba/ bkrag mdangs gzi byin dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ zhes pa nas/ karma kro dhe shwa rī a/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig ces 'don pa spo'o/ /gsum pa phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ sras mchog rnams bsangs sbyangs/ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ phur gdan gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs snying po 'bru bcu drug pa dang sgo ma bzhi'i sngags brjod/ e ma ag+ne man+ṭal sarba shā trun bagh+nān hūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya be ta li maṇ+ḍa

la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ sras mchog gi phur bu la yungs kar gtor zhing thum bu gdags/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma gu ta la ta la ta la pra ta la sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la naṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rak+ta byug pa'am byug tshul tsam bya/ a be sha ya a zhes phur pa lag tu blangs/ oṃ ha na ha na dībha tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ thal mo ka pu tas bzung*/ badz+ra satwa rā dza ya hūṃ/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas bzung*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes phur gdan gyi steng du gtsug pa/ sras mchog lnga yod cing spros pa la dga' na/ sngags de dag so so lan lnga lnga brjod/ gang ltar yang*/ skye med rnam dag chos sku'i dbyings nyid las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum ma lus sku/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /srid pa rdo rje phur bur sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings las bzhengs/ badz+ra añdza li dza mnyam pa'i thal mo bya/ phur bu rnams gtso bo yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas rigs lnga he ru kar gyur/ hūṃ dbus kyi mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /rdo rje 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ / zhe sdang bdud 'dul khro rgyal dbyings nas bzhengs/ /srid pa rdo rje phur bur sgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ de la 'don pa bsgyur te/ dbus kyi zhes pa/ shar phyogs lho phyogs nub phyogs byang phyogs rnams dang*/ mthing nag ces par/ smug nag ser nag dmar nag ljang nag ces dang*/ zhe sdang zhes par/ gti mug nga rgyal 'dod chags phrag dog ces 'don pa spo'o/ / de ltar sprul sku rigs lngar bzhengs par gsol ba btab pas/ he ru ka rigs lnga rnams lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ dīp+da badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

de bzhin du/ oṃ dīp+da tsakra dīp+ta rat+na/ dīp+da pad+ma/ dīp+takarma zhes 'don pa spos la brjod/ phur bu'i spyi bor oṃ/ sked par hrīḥ rtse mor phaṭa/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ zhes pa nas/ karma kro dha shwa rī a zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+ta maṇ+ḍa la= lag mthil gnyis su zla ba dang*/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la hūṃ oṃ swā āḥha las rgyal ba rigs lnga/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la muṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ yum lnga'i ngo bo/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra añdza lī hūṃ/ sor mo rnams bsnol/ badz+ra ban+dha rdor bsdams bya/ badz+ra añdza li dza ཿ zhais phur bu blangs/ a be sha ya a zhes cung zad bsgril tshul bya/ rigs lnga yab yum phur bu la thim/ /rgya mdud gong ma dang cung zhogs byed yan chad la/ phyogs bzhi dang steng gi khro bo/ man chad la mtshams bzhi dang 'og gi khro bo bzhugs par mos/ hūṃ dīp+da tsakra phur pa'i lha/ mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can/ /sku stod khro bo chen po la/ dbu gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs/ /lte ba man chad sku yi cha/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab ma 'dra/ /'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /lcags kyi phur bu zur gsum pa/ /drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ /btab na lha yang rlag 'gyur na/ /gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ kī la ya 'bru bcu drug pa lan gsum sogs ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ 'grub na/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal man chad/ sras mchog re re bzhin du tshar re grub na legs so/ / oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dz+wa la dz+wa la pra dz+wa la s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa sarba nā sha nā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces sras mchog gi gtso bo dpral bar reg oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya bya kri pa la hri sho dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ mgrin par reg oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ snying gar reg ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang blang ba'o/

/ gsum pa 'phrin las mchod pa rnam pa gsum ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can srungs ma dang bcas pa'i rnam par mchod pa'i don du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*/ /dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol/ khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang*/ rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*/ /badz+ra kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya staṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ sridagasum gdug pa 'dul ba dang*/ /nga rgyal chen po bstan pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la/ /rtse gcig yid kyi phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti bhu ho/ pra ti dza ho/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pā ri wa ra pā da bhan+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba la/ mchod pa'i gtso bo rnam gsum dang*/ zhar byung gi mchod pa'i rnam grangs gzhan no/ /dang po ni/ sman rag gtor gsum 'bul ba ste/ oṃ sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ / rgyud drug sems can kun grol phyir/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen la/ /thugs dam dbyings nyid skul ba'i phyir/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ / thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /bzhengs te kun tu dges mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ / dpal gyi yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/

/thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ye shes khro bo chen po bcu rnams dang*/ /shes rab dbyings kyi khro mo bcu rnams la/ /rnam dag sogs gong bzhin/ sprul pa khra thabs nyi shu sgo ma bzhi/ / gdug pa 'dul mdzad sras mchog rnam lnga la/ rnam dag= bka' yi pho nya yang sprul sum sprul dang*/ /srung mar dam bcas zhal bzhes thams cad la/ rnam dag= kun bzang rigs lnga dpal chen khrag 'thung sogs/ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma thams cad dang*/ /pra bha hasti pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs/ /rigs 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma thams cad dang*/ /mkhar chen mtsho rgyal rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs/ /gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma thams cad dang*/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad dang*/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ rnam dag= bar 'dir spros pa la dga' na/ sman bshags dang sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub blang pa sogs kyang byed do/ / hūṃ ma hā rak+ta bsgral ba'i khrag /mū la rak+ta rtsa ba'i khrag /pad+ma rak+ta sbyor ba'i khrag /chu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag /bsgral ba'i sha tshogs ri ltar spung*/ /'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /zhe sdang mchog phran gcal du bkram/ /tsi ta'i tshogs ni rdza ltar klags/ /dmar chen rgya mtsho chen po la/ /sna tshogs zhing gi me tog shar/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal du 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhengs su gsol/ /zhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā as+thi khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā gau ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ rak+ta gtor ma la lan gsum du sbran te/ dang po gtso bo yab yum/ gnyis pa 'jig rten 'das pa'i 'khor tshogs/ gsum pa dam can srung ma rnams la 'bul/ rak+ta tshar gsum gyi mchod pa zhes grags pa'i phyir/ gyer yang lan gsum byas na legs so/

/de nas gtor ma gsar pa yod na sngar bzhin byin rlabs kyang bya/ med na/ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta sogs byin rlabs lan gsum gyis kha gsos/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi rab tu brgyan/ /dam tshig bzhin du nus pas 'bul lags kyi/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes nas kyang*/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃ= puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī baṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ ba liṃ ta pra tīts+tsha hoḥ gṛh+na khā hi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gyer dang bcas pa lan gsum/ de ni gtor ma dngos yin la/ de rjes mchod pa rnam pa gsum char gyi 'jug sdoms ni/ snying po 'bru bcu drug pa'i mthar/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā raṃ khā hi ma hā rak+ta khā raṃ khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā raṃ khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun la sogs pas phul/ bsdu na de tsam gyis kyang chog de nas spro na rtsa brgyud bla ma'i mtshan nas smod pa dang*/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ sras mchog rnams dang*/ dam can rnams kyis bskyed sngags kyi mthar yang de zhin btags te 'bul/ khyad par du ha sa ya ra la sogs pa las sngags drug gi mthar oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa krodha ma hā ba liṃ ta sogs btags pas lan mang du 'bul/ lha rnams dgyes nas ha hā zhes gsungs/ hūṃ hūṃ zhes bdag la byin gyis rlabs/ phaṭa phaṭa ces dgra bgegs bsgral te chos nyid du spar bar gyur/ 'di ni sman raka gtor gsum zhes pa'i go rim ltar byas pa yin la/ yang phud sman rak+ta gsum zhes pa ltar gtor ma thog mar byas kyang rnying mar lugs mang po la yod pas mi legs pa ma yin no/ /gnyis pa zhor byung mchod pa'i rnam grangs la/ 'dod yon sna tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ rdo rje sgeg mo'i dga' bas mchod bya zhing*/ /rdo rje 'phreng mos rab tu brgyan byas te/ / rdo rje glu mas gsang ba'i glu blangs nas/

/rdo rje gar mas mdzod pa'i gar bsgyur ma/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams gang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la/ /rnam dag mos pa'i blo yis bdag 'bul lo/ / bzhes shig kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /rdo rje bdug pas ma lus tshim byas nas/ /rdo rje me tog ma yis mdzes par bkram/ /rdo rje sgron me ma yi dgyes pa bskyed/ /dri mchog ma yi dri zhim byug bya ba/ phyogs bcu'i sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra girti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nirnī a/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe drāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe a/ 'di ni sman mchod kyi 'phros don yin no/ / mchog tu gtsang ba'i mchod yon 'di/ /rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs la 'bul/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang*/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ /mchog tu gtsang ba'i zhabs bsil 'di/ = pā t+yaṃ/ =rin chen mdzes pa'i me tog 'di/ =puṣ+paṃ= zhing kun khyab pa'i bdug spos 'di/ =dhū paṃ= sgron me rin chen snang gsal 'd-i/ =dā+e paṃ= dri zhim ngad ldang byug pa 'di/ =gan+dha ཾ = ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas 'di/ = ne be t+yaṃ= rnam mang rol mo sil snyan 'di =shabha pra tīts+tsha swāhā'i bar du sbyar te/ 'di ni gtor ma'i yan lag go /de nas sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ 'khril pa'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /pad+ma la ni rdo rje zhugs/ / bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par shog /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /sgru?b pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po dag /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim/ /a la la te bzhes su gsol/

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho boḥbh+ri tsit+ta ma hā su khaṃ/ a nu rā ga ya mi de nas bsgral mchod ni/ dngos su ling ga bcas na dgug bzhug bya/ med na yid kyi byas par mos te/ dzaḥdam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ /phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ /shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ / bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ /sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ /bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la bab/ khyod kyi 'phrin las dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tsho pa/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yud tsam gyis ni 'dir bkug nas/ /mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*/ /lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang*/ /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ oṃ laṃ hūṃ laṃ staṃ bha naṃ mo haṃ gha ta ya/ bha ga wan hrīḥṣ+t-i bi kri ta shrī badz+ra hūṃ ka ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sarba bigh+nān badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra hūṃ ka ra hūṃ a/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /zung zhig sdoms shig rnam par chings/ /gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ / rings par khug la smra ru chug /phob cig rnam par gzir par gyis/ /nga yis dbang du gyur nas ni/ /bsgo ba'i las rnams nyan par gyis/ /hūṃ pa ra bi d+yaṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ dhin+dha dhin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ tāṃ ḍa ya tāṃ ḍa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hri daṇ+ḍahūṃ phaṭa/ shī gh+raṃ a na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dza la pā ya dza la pā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ a be sha ya a be sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bi dha ya bi dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/

o badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā hi/ bi da ya bi da ya badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā he/ dzaḥ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab// sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas pa'i/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las myur du mdzod/ ha na ha na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dzā la dzā la badz+ra/ su ru su ru badz+ra/ mu ru mu ru badz+ra/ ka taṃ ka ṭa ye dza ye bi dza ye/ a dzi te a pa ra dzi te/ ma ra s+ya na/ pra marda ne hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ /sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /stobs chen khro bo chen po yis/ /klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos/ /nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren rnams/ /nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ ma ma wa shaṃ ku ru tang nya ka ra i nan da dhe ma ma karma shī gh+raṃ ka ra ye/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi/ /lha'ang 'on te bdud kyang rung*/ /nga la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /sarba ā na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ /tā ṭa ya tā ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ brdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ / bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/ /rdo rje me dbal snying bsregs nas/ /

lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlogs/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ / rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas nas/ /lha yang rung ste bsgral bar bya'o/ kha tāṃ kha tāṃ kha tāṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas zhal du stabs pa ni/ hūṃ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan 'dren no/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /zhing chen gsar rnying ti ra'i tshogs/ /dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor 'khyil/ / mkha' 'gro 'bar ma'i tshogs rnams kyang*/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā sa ma ya/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de ltar sbyor sgrol kyi mchod pa de gnyis ni/ rak+ta'i mchod pa dang 'brel ba'o/ /de rjes bstod pas mchod pa ni/ hūṃ bskal me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /sku mdog dbus zhal mthing ka ni/ /chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i rtags/ /g.yas kyi zhal mdog dkar ba ni/ /bag chags skyon gyis ma gos rtags/ /g.yon gyi zhal mdog dmar ba ni/ /'gro ba'i don la chags pa'i rtags/ /dbu skra gyen du 'bar ba ni/ /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /spyan dgu sdang mig gzigs pa ni/ /thig dgu mtha' ru phyin pa'i rtags/ /rnam thar zhal gsum mche ba gtsigs/ /dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags/ /pha rol phyin pa'i phyag drug ste/ /rtse dgu sa dgu 'joms pa'i rtags/ /rtse lnga 'bar ba ye shes lnga/ /me dpung nyon mongs bag chags bsreg /kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum srid gsum gcod/ /ri rab phur pa 'gril ba ni/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rtags// tshar gsum 'phreng bas brgyan pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /nga rgyal phrag dog lta ngan rnams/ /dbyings su dag pa'i na bza' gsum/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/

/rtags mtshan gsum gyis sku la brgyan/ /klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa ni/ /rnam thar brgyad po rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum bzhugs pa ni/ /bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /yab yum gnyis su med par sbyor ba ni/ /dbyings dang ye shes don dam gcig pa'i rtags/ /khro bo yab yum nyi shus bskor ba ni/ /pha rol phyin dang shes bcu rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /khra thabs sgo ma sras mchog tshogs kyis bskor/ /sna tshogs sprul pas gdug pa 'dul ba'i rtags/ /ma bdun sring mos bskor sogs dmag dpung 'gyed/ /bse lcags dung gsum 'khor gyi bskor ba ni/ /grub pa'i rtags 'byin zhing bcu sgrol ba'i rtags/ /de ltar che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i/ /dpal bo chen po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ ces phyogs gzhan las dag dran bshad pa'i dod du skabs 'dir rtags bsdod bya/ de rjes don bstod byed par spro na'ang*/ 'og tu 'byung ba'i bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyipa sogs bya/ cung zad rgyas pa la mos na yig rnying rnams kyang shes par bya'o/ / de rjes la bzlas pa la 'jug dgos te/ /gnyis pa la bzlas pa'i sngon 'gro bzlas pa dngos rjes bstod pa ste gsum las/ dang po la rig 'dzin bskul ba dang*/ /'dzab kha dbye ba gnyis las/ thog ma ni/ hūṃ ma g.yel ma 'phangs rig 'dzin tshogs/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub kyi/ /byin gyis rlob cing gshegs su gsol/ /u rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ /pad+ma ge sar sdong po la/ /ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi/ /byin gyis rlobs phy-ir gshegs su gsol/ /rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i rigs/ /slob dpon pra bha ha ti rtsal/ srid pa'i phur bu bdag= byin gyis= dur khrod ming ni bsil pa tshal/

/slob dpon dha na sang kri ta/ slob dpon dha na sang kri ta*/ /slob dpon blo ldan mchog sred rtsal/ /rgya mtsho'i gling du bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /sa bdag klu gnyan btul ba bzhin/ /dam srid 'dul zhing gshegs su gsol/ /gza' dang rgyu skar btul ba bzhin/ /dgra bgegs 'dul zhing gshegs su gsol/ /srid pa'i phur bu= byin gyis = rgya gar yul du grub thob pa/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i 'byung gnas kyis// lho phyogs tsan dan nags tshal na/ /ji ltar rtags phyung bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /srid pa'i= byin gyis= bi ma la yi mi tra yis/ gaṅga lha yi chu bo la/ /ji ltar rtags phyung bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /srid pa'i= byin gyis= bal po'i yul du grub thob pa/ / rig 'dzin shī la mañdzu yis/ /man+dha la yi mkhar sgong la/ /ji ltar rtags sogs gong bzhin/ bod kyi yul du grub thob pa/ /sna naṃ rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis/ /yar klung sgrags kyi phu chu la/ ji ltar rtags= shud pu dpal gyi seng ge yis/ has po ri yi spang po la/ ji ltar rtags= 'chims chen shākya pra bha yis/ /'on cang rdo yi brag dmar la/ ji ltar rtags= mkhar rje za yi mtsho rgyal gyis/ /dgung gi pho rog nag po la/ ji ltar rtags= mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gis/ /rtsis kyi spyang khu sngon po la/ ji ltar rtags= phur bu= srid pa'i= byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'tshob pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /rig 'dzin sprul pa'i tshogs thams cad/ /bdag la byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes gyer ro/ /sngon 'gro gnyis pa 'dzab kha dbye ba ni/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug tshul ston zhing*/ /rgod dang gshe dang 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ / snying rje ma dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /sku yi dngos po gar dgur bsgyur ba ni/ / rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pas sgeg sgeg 'dra/

/bdud bzhi gdan du bting bas dpa' dpa' 'dra/ /sku che yan lag rags pas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra/ /g.yas zhal dkar la 'dzum pa sgeg sgeg 'dra/ /g.yon zhal dmar la gdangs pas gshe gshe 'dra/ /dbus zhal mthing la rngam pa khro khro 'dra/ /rgyud drug rjes su 'dzin pas brtse brtse 'dra/ /dgyes bde chags pas rol pa dam dam 'dra/ / chos sku mtshan ma med pas zhi zhi 'dra/ /rdo rje rtse dgus sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms/ /rtse lnga gdengs pas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol/ /me dpung 'bar bas 'khor ba'i nyon mongs sreg /kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod/ /ri rab phur bus dgra bgegs gzir bar byed/ /de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs mchod pa 'di bzhis la/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /bcom ldan dpal chen thugs kyi dgyes bde mo/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i yum/ /tshur gshegs sogs gong bzhin/ hūṃ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /rnam rgyal sgeg snyems stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /gshin rje dur khrod shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo /mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo /gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyems spyang khra'i mgo /'khyil pa rlung 'byin seng ge pha wang mgo /khams gsum gsod byed dred dang sre mong mgo /stobs chen bskul byed dom dang byi ba'i mgo /gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /de 'dra'i lha tshogs 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur byon sogs/ zhe sdang khros pa'i me ni mthing nag 'bar/ /gti mug khros pa'i me ni smug nag 'bar/ /'dod chags khros pa'i me ni dmar nag 'bar/ /phrag dog 'khros pa'i me ni ljang nag 'bar/ /gru gsum 'od lnga 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/

/rigs lnga rdo rje gzhon nu sku bzhengs shig /bdud dang log 'dren ma lus 'dus pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i lha tshogs 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur byon sogs/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' srung dam can tshogs/ /bdag nyid chen mo bzhi dang shwa na bzhi// bsre ba'i lha mo bzhi rnams ming por bcas/ /pho bdud nyi shu gcig sogs sde brgyad tshogs/ /rang rang las la brtson pa'i pho nya rnams/ /tshur byon sogs gong bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ bcom ldan yab yum thabs shes gnyis su med/ /rnam sprul khro bo yab yum pho nya'i tshogs/ yum ring dus nas bsnyen zhing bsgrubs pa'i lha/ / drag po rang byung dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs gsol ba btab nas bzlas pa bya ste/ sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs su kī la ya 'bru bcu drug pa nyid ci nus su bzla zhing*/ khro bcu las sngags dang bcas pa dang*/ sgo ma'i sngags rnams cung zad re bzla yi/ grangs nges gzung can mi dgos so/ /gsum pa rjes bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ /yid kyis sgrub sprul pa'i mchod pa dang bcas te/ hūṃ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs dbyings phyug shes rab bcas/ /gtso bo yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bcu dregs pa bsnon pa'i gdan stengs su/ /mthu chen bdud 'dul khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis srid gsum 'khor ba 'jig /'jigs byed khro rgyal tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen dbyings nas 'bar ba'i sku bzhengs ma/ /thabs mchog sku la so sor dgyes pas 'khyud/ /shes rab tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /ye shes khro mo bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khams gsum dbang bsdud thugs rje sprul pa'i sku/ /gtum khros za gsod rnam 'phrul pho nya'i tshogs/ /phyag rgya rnam bzhis 'dul mdzad sgo skyong ma/

/rdo rje phra men tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal gyi sras mchog rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /yak+ṣa me dbal sprul pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /smon lam dbang gi dregs pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /dpal gyi bka' sdod sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de rnams kyis dngos gzhi'i cho ga bstan zin no/ /rnying ma'i lugs kyi sgrub mchod la bdag 'jug gi lag len mdzad pa nyung bas sgrub mchod tsam la bdag 'jug ma grub kyang mi 'gal mod/ spyir 'grub na legs pas gal te byed na skabs 'dir bzang ste/ bdag 'jug ni dngos gzhi'i cho ga yin pas so/ /'on kyang phur chog gsar pa rnams kyi lag len la ni/ 'di nas lhag ma'i rjes yan chad du bdag 'jug gi dus ma nges par byed pa'ang snang ngo*/ /de la bdag 'jug ni dbang gi yi ge las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gsum las/ dang po tshogs kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs rdzas rnams bshams/ bdud rtsi gtor la/ bsangs sbyangs/ raṃ gyi mes bsregs zhes pa nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur gyi bar gtor ma byin rlabs dang 'dra/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang/ zhes pa nas/ dngos grub stsol/ dam tshig chen po gshegs su gsol/ / sprul pa chen po gshegs su gsol/ phyag brnyan chen po= shwa na mu kha= bdag nyid chen mo= sa bdag chen mo= bran dang pho nya= 'khor bcas thams cad= khro bo 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang*/ rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ tshogs phud cha gsum du bya/ /dang po snod du bcug la stegs mtho bar bzhag bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ zhes pa nas/ yak+ṣa krau dha kha kha khā hi khā hi'i bar gong gtor ma'i skabs bzhin/ gar byas 'grub bo rnal 'byor pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che/ /zla ba la sogs snying po can/ maṃ sa la sogs ro mchog gsol/ me tog la sogs tsan dan 'phreng*/ / bzang rgu 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/

/mdzes rgu 'bul lo gzigs su gsol// bda' rgu 'bul lo rol du gsol/ /snyan rgu 'bul lo gsan du gsol/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya sogs/ gong bzhin/ tshogs bar pa la dmigs te/ tshe rabs bskal pa thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta lus 'di blangs pa tshun chod du/ /lus kyi sdig byas sdig pa dngos su bgyis/ /ngag gi 'khyal tshig smra ba ngan du chug /sems kyi blo nor log par bsam pa sogs/ /'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa/ /bkra ba'i lha tshogs khyed la bzod par gsol/ /ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ /de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams/ /mi yi skyon mthong tsa na chad pas gcod/ /nongs par gyur kyang bka' chad ma gcod cig /mthu rtsal ci yod dgra dang bgegs la sprugs/ /bstan pa 'jig sogs nyes skyon ma gzigs sam/ /sgrub po'i nyes pa phran tshogs dbyings su thim/ /nyams par gyur pa longs spyod tshogs kyis bskang*/ /dam bskong dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ tshogs tha ma ni/ gzugs brnyan du byas la/ spros pa la dga' na/ khro bo bcu nas phur srungs kyi bar gyis bskul rnams bya/ bsdu na dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ sogs la tshang pas bskul logs pa med kyang chog /bden pa brdar ba spyi dang 'dra ba las/ 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung*/ yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phur pa 'phrin las/ ma mo rbod gtong*/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ smod pa drag sngags/ 'dus pa mdo/ rgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra /rnal 'byor dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad dang*/ khyad par du 'di zhes bya ba skad cig thad cig yud tsam la bsgral ba'i las kyi gnas 'dir mchis par gyur cig

/che ge mo 'di'i rgyab brten dang dpung gnyen byed pa'i pho lha dang yul lha dang srog lha dang*/ dgra lha dang zhang lha la sogs pa nyon cig /gnod byed dgra bgegs 'di dag gi /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig rnal 'byor pa'i sku la bdos/ dben gnas dang chos gzhi dbral/ las bzang rgu ni spangs/ las ngan rgu ni byas pa yin pas/ 'di la srung ba ma byed/ mgon skyabs ma byed/ yal bar thong cig /gal te 'di'i rgyab rten dang dpung gnyen byed na/ khyed cag rnams dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'i chad pas bcad nas/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal bar skyes te/ thar med kyi sdug bsngal myong bar the tshom med do/ /yul phyogs 'di dag na gnas pa'i yul bdag gnas bdag klu gnyan sa bdag la sogs pa 'jig rten dregs pa can thams cad kyang nyon cig /bdag cag khyed rnams la gnod pa mi byed do/ /drag sngags kyi me dbal mi gtong*/ / phur pa'i rtse mi gtod/ yungs kar gyi rbab mi sgril/ drag rdzas kyi thun zor mi brdeg /drag po'i pho nya mi 'gyed do/ /bdag cag ni dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i zhing bcu 'di rnams 'gugs pa yin pas/ khyed rnams ko long ma sdom/ ma 'jigs/ ma skrag /ma bsdangs bar dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' rtags 'dzin par nga yi rgyab dang dpung gyis shig /gdug pa can 'di da lta nyid du khug la bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig
