ces snyan gsan dbab pa lan gsum bya/ de nas rgyas pa la mos na/ khro bo bcu nas phur srungs bar gyi bskul rnams bya ste pho nya gtong ba yin/ bsdu na/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ sogs la tshang bas 'dir ma brjod kyang chog /de nas bden brdar sogs gong du bshad pa dang spyi 'gros dang mthun pa'i tshig gis liṅga dgug 'dren bya/ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ ces pa nas/ zhal du stab pa'i bar gong bsgral mchod kyi skabs bzhin no/ /'di tsam ni bsdus pa'i lugs yin la/ rgyas pa ni/ gong ma rnams kyis mdzad zin pa las shes par bya la/ 'bring po 'tsham pa zhig gzhan du yang 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /'di skabs ling ro rnams gtor ma la btab/ cha shas cung zad tsam tshogs rdzas dang yang bsre/ cung zad cig lhag gtor gtsang ma dang yang bsre'o/ /de rjes brda dang brda'i lan dang 'bul len sogs spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la rol lo/ /rjes chog gnyis pa lhag ma'i gtor ma ni/ lhag ma rnams snod cig tu bsdus nas rme gtor gyi tshul du bsham/ de'i 'gram du lhag ma gtsang gtor yang bzhag /bdud rtsis bran/ oṃ mahā ba liṃ ta/ sogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ / yum chen 'khor lo'i rgyas 'debs kyi/ /sprul pa'i pho nya dpag yas dang*/ /grub pa gsang ba 'bar ma'i tshogs/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /tshur gshegs gtor ma 'di la bzhes la/ /rdo rje lcam dral srung ba dang*/ /rkyen las byung ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni med par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /re smon thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ de nas lhag gtor gnyis dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i spyi gtor gtor gral nas blangs pa nas blangs pa rnams rdo rje 'gros kyis phyi snur du bzhag /rak+tas bran/ 'di skad ces/ 'jig rten las 'das pho nya mo/

/yang dag sku gcig byung ba ni/ /dpal gyi pho nya lcags kyu 'dzin/ /'di 'dra gcig pur ma nges te/ /stong khams khyab par sprul byed ma/ /shar gyi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten las 'das pho nya mo/ /yang dag sku gcig byung ba ni/ /dung gi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ / ral pa lcang lo re re la/ /pho nya kyu thogs sprin ltar gtibs/ /shar lho mtshams nas gshegs su gsol/ de gnyis kun la 'gre ste/ dpal gyi pho nya zhags pa thogs/ 'di 'dra= stong khams= lho yi= lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ ral pa= pho nya zhags thogs= lho nub mtshams= dpal gyi lcags sgrog= 'di 'dra= stong khams= nub kyi= zangs kyi spyang mo= ral pa= pho nya sgrog thogs= nub byang = dpal gyi= dril bu= 'di 'dra= stong khams= byang gi phyogs= g.yu yi spyang mo= ral pa= pho nya dril thogs= byang shar= lcags kyi byi ba chen po la/ /mi mo lcags kyi tshul can zhon/ /lha srin sde brgyad phung byed ma/ /'og gi phyogs nas= lcags kyi bya khra brgyad khri la/ /mi mo lcags kyi= lha srin sde brgyad skyong byed ma/ steng gi phyogs nas= sngon kyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pas mchod/ /chem chem dgongs shig sa ma ya/ /'dir gshegs bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan yang dpal gyi bka' nyan pa/ /khyab byed chen po khyung gi mgo /'jigs byed chen po spyang ki'i mgo /gsod byed chen po dred kyi mgo /'byin byed byi la pu shud mgo /smyo byed ltos 'phye rmigs bu'i mgo /rkun byed chen po byi ba'i mgo /za byed chen po stag gi mgo /sgron byed seng ge pha wang mgo /phra men chen po khyed rnams kyang*/ bye ba brgya stong 'khor dang bcas/ sngon gyi thugs dam= = = = 'bar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /'bar ba chen mo lus 'bar rnams/ /dpal chen sku la 'phro zhing 'du/ /'bar ma nyi ma'i zhags pa 'debs/ /'bar ma me khyer glog 'phreng 'dzin/

/'bar ma gshin rje skar mda' 'phen/ /'bar ma ser mo mdun thung 'phen/ /'bar ma klu mo lce 'bebs ma/ /'bar ma rlung bdag ral gri'i skra/ /'bar ma gnod sbyin khyung thogs ma//'bar ma gtum mo ba lang rna/ /'bar ma chen po khyed rnams kyang*/ sngon gyi= = = = oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ liṃ hūṃ/ oṃ bud+dha ṭā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba la ིཾ oṃḥ oṃ rat+na ṭā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ drwaṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥ oṃ karma ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ a/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ ho/ lan gsum gyis stab/ de nas lhag ma rme gtor gtsang gtor gnyis bsres/ tshogs phud bar pa la blugs/ kha khrus btab la/ /spyi gtor ni de la bsres kyang chog ma bsres kyang chog /yang cung zad phyir snur la/ /sman dang rak+ta cung zad bran/ 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod/ hūṃ sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka'i/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /grub pa dbang phyug ma tshogs ma/ /klas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /rgyal mo blon mo ded dpon ma/ / g.yog mo dang ni yang g.yog ma/ /bran dang yang bran 'khor dang bcas/ sngon gyi= = = = sngon tshe dpal= spyan sngar= /shar gyi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /dkar mo dung gi thor tshugs can/ /lho yi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /sngon mo gzig gi sham thabs can/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /dmar mo zangs kyi lan phran can/ / byang gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /gser gyi 'od zer mda' 'phen ma/ steng gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /rnam sprul ma nges cir yang ston/ /'og gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /ru dra sgrol ba'i mthu mo che/ dpal gyi lha mo shugs 'gro ma/ khyod ni nam mkha'i rgyal mo ste/ sngon gyi= = = =gling bzhi mgyogs ma lha yi sring*/ /shar gyi mgyogs ma gshegs su gsol/ /mkha' la khyung lding gshin rje'i lcam/ /lho yi mgyogs ma=

dkar sham g.yas thod klu yi sring*/ /nub kyi mgyogs= nag mo sder chen gnod sbyin srid/ /byang gi mgyogs ma= sring mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang*/ sngon tshe= spyan sngar= tshangs ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ gar ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /ma sring la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /'bar ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ /pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams/ /sngon gyi sogs gong bzhin/ bar 'di srung ma rnams la las brtse ba stai/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dpal sa btsan/ /bar snang khams kyi mthun mo che/ /chos kyi dbyings na bzhugs tsa na/ /rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /rgya mtsho'i gting na bzhugs tsa na/ /rdo rje me za brag gyon ma/ /bha ga'i klong na bzhugs tsa na/ /yum chen bha ga hri ti ma/ / bar snang khams na rgyu bas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ston bzhin sha ba zhon pa par+ṇa sha ba ri/ /nam gyi gung phyed rgyu bas nam gru mthu mo che/ /ri rab rtse la bzhugs nas gling bzhi skyong mdzad ma/ gling bzhi kun byams drag mo rgyal/ / mi gcig ma la ming dgu ma/ /mkhan brgya ma la mtshan stong ma/ /gang la bya ba nor ra re/ /skyod cig rgya mtsho'i gting nas bskyod/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel yal gam can/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ /zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la/ /zangs kyi mi mo chen mo zhon/ /mig ni nyi ma'i zer las 'tsher/ /spu ni ral gri'i so bas rno/ /sder mo lcags kyu 'bar ba 'dra/ /'jug ma lcags kyu bsdogs pa bzhin/ /bang ni glog gi bskyod du med/ /skad ni stong khams khyab par sgrog /g.yas pa rdo rje ri rab brnyel/ / g.yon pa zangs kyi zhags pa thogs/ /gang la bya ba nor ra re/ /skyod gcig ri rab rtse nas bskyod/ /ma g.yel bcol ba'i= sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ / bse yi lha mo ched bzhi las/ /gcig ni bal yul mthil na bzhugs/

/mar khu'i mtsho la gnas bcas shing*/ khyod kyi bka' nyan 'bum sde ni/ /nang yang mar khu'i mtsho la 'du/ /nub kyang mar khu'i mtsho la 'du/ /rgya mtsho'i gting na 'du 'du ba/ /mthing nag ral pa sha ra ra/ /dbang gi bse khrab si li li/ /bse yi ral pa si li li/ /ral pa re la phur pa re/ khyod ni bdud kyi bu mo ste/ / 'chibs su bdud rta nag po 'chibs/ /na bza' ber chen mthing nag gsol/ / brda ni mi 'phraud lho bal mon/ /skad ni mi go ldab ma ldib/ /dri ni mi zhim chi li li/ /gzugs ni mi sdug lag brgya ma/ /g.yon pa lnga bcu lcags kyu 'dzin/ / g.yas pa lnga bcu phur bu bsgril/ /lcags kyus bzung la phur bus thob/ badz+ra ku lan+dha ra'i dus la bab/ / de yis rigs 'gre ste/ sa bdag= bse yi= gcig ni tsha ba'i rong na bzhugs/ zhag gi mtsho la= khyod kyi bka' nyan= nang yang zhag gi= nub kyang zhag gi= rgya mtsho'i gting = mthing nag= dbang gi= bse yi= ral pa re= khyod ni gza' yi= 'chibs su gza' rta zhur po= nab bza' ber chen ser khra= brda ni= skad ni= dri ni= gzugs ni= g.yon pa= g.yas pa= lcags kyus= badz+ra shu lan+dha ra'i/ de bzhin du sbyar nas/ gcig ni mang yul bse na= rak+ta'i mtsho= khyod kyi= nang yang = nub kyang = rgya mtsho'i= mthing nag= dbang gi= bse yi= ral pa= khyod ni btsan gyi= 'chibs su btsan rta dmar po= nab bza' ber chen dmar khra= brda ni= skad ni= dri ni= gzugs ni= g.yon pa= g.yas pa= lcags kyus/ badz+ra tsa mun+dha ra'i dus la bab/ /gcig ni gnya' nam bri na bzhugs/ /'o ma'i= khyod kyi= nang yang = nub kyang 'o ma'i/ rgya mtsho= mthing nag= dbang gi= bse= ral pa= khyod ni klu yi= 'chibs su klu rta sngon po= nab bza' ber chen sngon po= brda ni= skad ni= dri ni= gzugs ni= g.yon pa= g.yas pa= lcags kyus= badz+ra kang ka dha ra'i dus la bab/ hūṃ/ pho nya bran dang mngags pa'i tshogs/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bdud nag chen po ral chen dang*/

/bdud rje zla ba ka la drag /bdud rje ro langs khrag mig dang*/ /dur khrod nag po snying dkar te/ /dung gi skyes bu mched bzhi dang*/ / tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ /shing gyi dmar po ma ru rtse/ skyes bu phya sangs dkar po dang*/ /nag po srog bdud chen po ste/ /lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi po dang*/ /skyes bu gying chen ma ru rtse/ /skyes bu gshin rje ma ru rtse/ /skyes bu bdud nag ma ru rtse/ /skyes bu gnod sbyin ma ru rtse/ /bse yi skyes bu mched bzhi dang*/ khyab pa lce rings skya gcig pu/ /nag po 'dzum med so brdar 'khrigs/ /nag po skrag med gshin rje'i gtso/ /gsod byed 'bar ma 'jog po klu/ /srog gcod shan pa mched bzhi dang*/ /sa bdag blon po rtsang kun dang*/ /bdud kyi blon po spyang ki'i mgo /gdeng pa snying dkar klu yi blon/ /'brog gnas gnod sbyin blon po dang*/ /'byung po ser po sna yon po/ /de ltar pho bdud nyer gcig rnams/ / rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /yid la brnags pa'i las mdzod cig / bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi ni/ /nag mo khrag gi ral pa can/ /srod la dgra bo'i snying 'byin ma/ /nag mo zhag gi ral pa can/ /nam phyed dgra bo'i srog gcod ma/ /nag mo dung gi ral pa can/ /nyi shar dgra bo'i bla dgugs ma/ / nag mo zangs kyi ral pa can/ /tho rangs dgra bo'i sha la rol/ /de ltar nag mo mched bzhi po/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /sarba a na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ta tha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te lhag gtor phyi rol du dor ro/ /gsum pa nyer bsdu'i bya ba la/ bstan ma bskul ba/ dngos grub blang ba/ bzod gsol/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ bdag nyid srung ba/ smon lam gdab pa rnams yod pa las/ dang po ni/ ho bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ sngon gyi dam bca' las mi 'da' bar/

dpal chen po'i pham phabs la gnos te/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi gdong grogs la 'dir gshegs shig dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ dza/ hūṃ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams/ / sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs te/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bdag nyid chen po rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan lha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong*/ /gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun du bzang*/ /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud kyi bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi dang*/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ /mkha' rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje rlung mo dang*/ /smangs ri rab 'jom rdo rje grags mo rgyal/ /gnod sbyin bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi dang*/ /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong*/ /btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil/ /g.yu'i dril snyan rdo rje zur le ma/ /sman btsun bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi ste/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas rnams kyang*/ /sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs nas/ /lhab lhub rin chen mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /pho nya bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /sil snyan rol mo mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /che ge chen mo khyed rnams kyang*// rdo rje thod 'phreng spyan snga ru/ /zhing chen tshogs kyi mchod bkram nas/ /rnam lnga bdud rtsi'i longs spyod kyis/ /dbang bskur ming btags dam mnos te/ /thar pa thob par ming yang grags/ /lag tu rdo rje byin nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gral du bzhag /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /rnal 'byor sgrub po'i grogs mdzod cig /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/

/bcol ba'i las rnams grub bar mdzod/ ces bstan ma bskyang ngo*/ /de nas gtor ma zor du 'phang pa'i srol yang yod mod/ dkyus la mi dgos pas ji ltar bde bar gshegs las bzhi'i bro brdung ba ni/ gtor snod kha sbub la/ hūṃ dang po gti mug nyid las byung*/ /bar du gti mug nyid la 'khor/ /tha mar gti mug nyid kyis 'dul/ /gti mug rdo rje'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /dngul lam dkar po'i shing dag la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse mo zlum/ /logs la bzhi ba'i lha bsgoms te/ khong stong byang chub sems lung bstan/ /rtse mo zlum po lta ba yis/ /thams cad ma lus zhi bar 'gyur/ /zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med/ /zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin du 'don pa spos la/ gti mug ces par/ nga rgyal zhes dang*/ gser ram ser po'i shing = mgo bo rgya mdud zur bzhi rtse/ /logs la rgyas pa'i= khong stong = rtse mo zur bzhi= zhi ba zhes pa rnams su rgyas pa/ yang de bzhin du gti mug ces par/ 'dod chags/ zangs sam dmar po'i= rtse zla gam/ logs la dbang gi= khong stong = rtse mo zla gam= zhi ba'i

gnas su dbang gi dang*/ dbang du= dbang sdud lha= de bzhin du / gti mug ces par/ zhes sdang*/lcags sam nag po'i= =rtse zur gsum/ logs la drag po'i= khong stong = rtse mo zur gsum= ma lus rlag par 'gyur/ 'joms par ma gyur 'joms mdzad lha= re re'i mthar kī la ya sbyar ro/ / dngos grub blang ba ni/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs dgongs su gsol/ /dang po bsnyen pa'i dbu btsugs nas/ /bsnyen pa'i dus kyang mtha' ru phyin/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i sgo ru zhugs/ /do nub yan chad zhag grangs thems/ /bzlas brjod grangs kyang thems lags kyi/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /mgon po thugs rje byon pa na/ khyed kyi thugs dam stsal bas na/ /'gro ba mang po grol slad du/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /sgrub mchog bdag gi rnam rtog sbyangs pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dngos grub stsol/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /'gro ba ma lus byang chub don byas te/ /dpal chen he ru ka yi go 'phang mchog /da lta nyid du thob pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs pa'i mgo / zhes pa nas/ gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /dpal gyis bka' gnyan ye shes lha kun gyi/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'gro ba drug la thugs rtser dgongs su gsol/ / rdzu 'phrul dbang ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sems la dbang ba'i= ye shes= tshe la= skye ba= chos la= yo byad= las la= smon lam= mos pa= bsdu dngos bzhi yi= mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ khams gsum bsgral ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ khro rgyal sku yi= gsung gi= thugs kyi= yon tan 'phrin las dngos grub stsal du gsol/

/rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /shwa na la sogs bka' yi pho nya'i tshogs/ /sgrub pa rtags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ma tshogs nam gru re ma tī yi tshogs/ /pho nya bka' sdod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdo rje ya sbyin la sogs dam can tshogs/ /rdzu 'phrul drag po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ye shes lha dang mkha' 'gro srungs ma'i tshogs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / dkyus kyi cho ga'i yan lag la nges par dgos pa min yang skabs 'di'am/ gong 'dzab bzlas kyi mthar/ tshe chog logs su yod pa ltar rang gzhan gyi don du spro na bya ste/ de'i tshe tshe chog gi mthar mchod bstod kyang bya'o/ /gang ltar yang de rjes yig brgya mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/ lta ba spangs pas chos nyid don ma rtogs/ /sgom pa yun thung yi dam lha ma gsal/ /bsnyen sgrub yun thung dngos grub mthu ma brnyes/ /'bad rtsol chung bas slob dpon thugs ma dgyes// brtse gdung chung pas mched lcam thugs dang 'gal/ /le lo snyoms las mchod pa ma tshang bas/ /ye shes lha spangs dngos grub g.yel ba'i rgyu/ /de sogs nongs par gyur pa ci bgyis pa/ /bkra ba'i lha tshogs spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /nyes skyon thams cad dbyings su dag gyur cig /ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs spyi dang 'dra bar bzod gsol byas/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs/ 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ nyi ma tha ma la yin na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar bsdus nas 'od gsal du mnyam par bzhag / ā ka ro'i/ sngags kyis las rjes bsdu ba spyi dang 'dra/ dge 'dis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i kī la ya'i// go 'phang byang chub myur thob nas/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal bar shog / ces sogs smon lam gdab cing*/ huṃ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi sku sprul pa/

/bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mi 'gyur rtag pa'i don gyi bkra shis shog /'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum gyi bkra shis shog /sprul pa'i khro rgyal bcu yi bkra shis shog /shes rab khro mo bcu yi bkra shis shog /yang sprul phyag brnyan tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /ye shes sgo skyong bzhi yi bkra shis shog /'phrin las sras mchog rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can bka' sdod tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /dge legs 'bras bur smin pa'i bkra shis shog / gzhan yang shis brjod kyi khyad par ji ltar 'os pa brjod do// de ltar dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud 'joms rol pa ces bya ba 'di ni/ 'khon lugs kyi las byang rnying pa sa chen gyis mdzad par yangabyed pa 'di la gtso bor brten/ de yang snubs lugs kyi las byang dang phal cher mthun par 'dug cing*/ gzhan kha skongs dgos pa yang gdams ngag drug pa dang*/ /skyi lugs sogs sngags rnying bka' ma rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs shing*/ gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs sogs spangs te rang lugs gtsang zhing dag par brjod pa ni/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'i sug las so// // zhus dag/ bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud 'joms rol ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 120--PAGE 121--PAGE 116-
